newsitem.title: USA: Tandy Corp sees Q3 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Tandy Corp sees Q3 below expectations.

text.p: Tandy Corp said on Thursday that its third earnings are expected to be in the $0.30 to $0.35 a share range -- which is below Wall Street's expectations for the company to earn $0.59 a share.
In last year's third quarter, Tandy reported earnings per share of $0.66.
Tandy said sales at Radio Shack and Incredible Universe were among the best in the consumer electronics business for the third quarter, but they were less than last year and lower than planned.
Tandy's Computer City unit had higher promotional expenses for the anniversary of Microsoft Corp Windows '95 computer operating system software, Tandy said.
